summary: Bulletin 277 decreased the credit accident and health single premium rates by 6.1%. The reduced rates should be effective no later than July 1, 2025, the date shown; insurers could use them any time after the bulletin of December 19, 2024. Headline rates are the 12- and 60-month rates.
